brief: Council brief 025 (D156 #3, rank #3); SYNTHESIS_025.md section 6.3 EXP-23; D153(xiii); D158(1)-(7)
label: OBSERVED (completion cells) + DERIVED (logs, shares, required values, interval, verdicts) + DECLARED-THRESHOLD (90 pp) + CITATION-ONLY (kappa)
statement: Descriptive bound on the D63 upper-secondary residual. The log gap between the declared 90 pp level and observed upper-secondary completion 2024 splits at the declared one-stage pair (upper 2024 / lower 2021) into a pipeline-level share and a transition-ratio share; three comparisons then ask whether the required lower completion, the required transition ratio and the implied upper interval lie inside the observed record's envelope. No model was run; no value was adopted; no re-fit; no causal claim; no direction claim. D63 stays UNABLE as to cause regardless of the verdicts. The observed ratio range is consumed as a range, not re-tested, and CEIL-ATTRIB is not re-run or re-scored.

verdict.split_rule: RESIDUAL-SPLIT iff both shares lie in [1/3, 2/3]; PIPELINE-DOMINANT iff pipeline_share > 2/3; RATIO-DOMINANT iff ratio_share > 2/3; THIN rule below 3 pairs
verdict.bounds_rule: BOUNDS-INSIDE iff all three comparisons INSIDE; BOUNDS-OUTSIDE iff all three OUTSIDE; BOUNDS-EDGE iff mixed; precedence stated in the predeclaration, no tolerance anywhere
verdict.d63_status_note: fixed by the block, D153(vi) and D153(xiii); no outcome of this cell changes it
verdict.branch_fired: BOUNDS-EDGE -> the record bounds the residual on the transition-ratio channel and not on the pipeline channel; the sentence calling the ceiling structural is unavailable, and so is its opposite.

bounds.pair_set_crosscheck: n = 8 and the (upper year, lower year) set matches PIPE_LOO_PAIRS.csv, ratios at 4 dp

sensitivity_non_verdict_bearing.label: DESCRIPTIVE / NOT-VERDICT-BEARING
sensitivity_non_verdict_bearing.why_reported: the declared split uses the t-3 pair; at the contemporaneous lower value the pipeline term changes sign, so the split may not be cited as lag-free

predeclaration.enforcement_note: code/run_d63_bounds.py embeds the sha256 as PREDECL_SHA256 and aborts before any computation on mismatch; no hash in any verdict row is RECORDED-NOT-ENFORCED
predeclaration.authored_by: code/author_predecl.py (mechanical splice of the Council's text; no manual transcription)

10_massification/extensions/synthetic_20.role: CITATION-ONLY (synthetic context; no model value enters any bound)

declared_parameters.target_status: DECLARED-THRESHOLD (D34/A6, 90/90/90 pp), not an observed object, not a policy target here
declared_parameters.tie_break: nearest lower year to t-3 within +/-1 y, ties toward the earlier year (the EXP-1 build_pairs rule)

determinism.note: no RNG, no network, no clock value in any result file; the two runs are byte-identical

findings_number_register.rule: every number in FINDINGS.md must appear in results/D63_BOUNDS_DETAIL.csv with path+column+derivation

declared_limits: 8 Philippine pairs only: the observed ratio range is a single-system range and the bounds inherit that
the declared t-3 lag is a choice: at the contemporaneous lower value the pipeline share changes sign (sensitivity reported, non-verdict-bearing)
the record maximum lower completion is the 2024 cell, contemporaneous with the residual's upper cell; B1 therefore compares a 2021-based requirement with a 2024 maximum
the 90 pp level is a declared threshold, not an observed object; the cell does not evaluate whether 90 is the right bar
B2/B3 combine observed numbers from different years; the joint combination was never observed, and an interval containing 90 is not evidence that 90 would have been reached
the split is an accounting identity with zero free parameters and zero residual by construction: it cannot fail, so only the band and the bounds are tests
the cell is upper-level by construction and may not be cited about the lower level or a two-level object
three of the eleven observed upper years cannot enter the pair set (no lower observation within the declared tolerance of the exact three-year lag)
closed_claims: no model run; no model value in any bound
no re-fit, no grid, no second estimand, no adoption
does not re-run or re-score CEIL-ATTRIB; its [0.90, 1.10] band test is not recomputed (the 8 ratios are consumed as a range)
does not re-score EXP-18, EXP-21, PIPE-LOO, LOWER-DEF or any of the 33 cells
no causal claim; no direction claim; no forecast; no policy target
D63 stays UNABLE as to cause; the barred structural-ceiling sentence and its opposite both remain unwritten
no write outside 10_massification/extensions/d63_bounds_2026-11-20/; every input opened read-only
no web; the running server was not touched
